item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Five Café Photos With Music

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos, in the order attached. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions.

item.tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all five: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Relaxed instrumental music; no vocals or voiceover. Track choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Transitions and framing: Smooth transitions; other editing and framing choices are your call.

must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos in the order attached: the storefront pic, the latte pic, the pastries pic, the barista pic, and the interior pic. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent any credits.** For this request, a photo slideshow is cheaper and more reliable than AI video generation—it will preserve your actual photos and their order.

### Recommended: 0 Magic Hour credits
Use a standard video editor such as Instagram’s editor or CapCut:
- **10 seconds, vertical 9:16**
- Photos in order: **storefront → latte → pastries → barista → interior**
- About **2 seconds per photo**, with gentle zooms and smooth crossfades
- Relaxed instrumental music from a library licensed for your intended use
- No text

Your landscape photos will need cropping or a blurred background to fit vertically.

### What would Magic Hour cost?
| Option | Magic Hour credits |
|---|---:|
| Assemble existing photos in another editor, using included music | **0** |
| Generate instrumental music in Magic Hour | **15 minimum**—1 credit/second, with a 15-second minimum; trim to 10 seconds afterward |
| AI-generated video | **I can’t verify an exact quote with the connected tools**, so I won’t run it |

**Limitation:** the connected Magic Hour tools don’t offer a straightforward slideshow assembler that guarantees all five photos in that exact sequence with transitions and a music track. Generating a new video is not an equivalent substitute.

**Cheaper, shorter, or smaller?** The 0-credit slideshow is already the cheapest route. A 5-second version or 480p export would be shorter or smaller, but wouldn’t reduce that cost. Shortening the music below 15 seconds also wouldn’t reduce Magic Hour’s minimum music charge.

My recommendation: **keep your 10-second plan and use a standard editor with included instrumental music.**
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:
The cheapest option is **0 Magic Hour credits**, using Instagram’s editor or CapCut. I can’t operate those apps or assemble the slideshow with the connected tools, so I haven’t generated or charged anything.

Here’s the exact setup:
1. Create a **9:16 vertical** project and import all five photos in the attached order.
2. Set the reel to **10 seconds**, with roughly **2 seconds per photo**.
3. Add short **dissolve transitions** and gentle zooms. Adjust timing after transitions so the total stays 10 seconds.
4. Use a **blurred background** behind landscape photos to avoid heavy cropping.
5. Add a free, relaxed instrumental track licensed for your use; trim it to 10 seconds and fade out.
6. Export with **no text**.

No paid AI generation is needed.
